```python
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for each product and period
I = {}  # Inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining: I[p,l,t,r]
sales = {}  # Sales for each product, location, period, and remaining life
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for each product, location, and period
W = {}  # Waste for each product, location, and period

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Set objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]
            for r in range(2, SL+1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"demand_sat_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) 
                            for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Non-negativity constraints are handled by default variable bounds

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
I = m.addVars(P, L, T, [r for r in range(1, max(shelf_life.values())+1)], name="I")
W = m.addVars(P, L, T, name="W")
lost_sales = m.addVars(P, L, T, name="lost_sales")

for p in P:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

for p in P:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

for p in P:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

for p in P:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

for p in P:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

for l in L:
    for t in T:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in P)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in P for t in T)
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r]) for p in P for l in L for t in T for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, SL+1)) + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products) <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * sum_r sales[p,l,t,r]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products) <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Non-negativity
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p,l,t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] >= 0)

# Initial inventory: I[p,l,1,r] = 0 for all p,l,r (no initial inventory)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]
# Inventory holding cost (charged on END-of-period inventory after sales, exclude r=1)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, SL+1):
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])
# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]
# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"cold_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * sum_r sales[p,l,t,r]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Non-negativity constraints are handled by variable bounds (default in Gurobi)

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            # (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Demand satisfaction constraint (no substitution)
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, SL + 1))
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand, name=f"demand_sat_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Inventory aging for next period (for t < periods)
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    # (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1]
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                # For r=SL at t+1, it will be set by fresh inflow constraint in next period

# Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity constraints (though usage is 0, include for completeness)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(
            labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

holding_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
    for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
    for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1)  # r >= 2
)

waste_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(
    costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1)
)

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium'] = {}
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"S_Basic_Premium_{l}_{t}")

# Initial inventory (assume zero initial inventory)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
for t in periods:
    # Production capacity constraints
    for p in products:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= data['production_cap'][p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
    
    # Fresh inflow constraint (1)
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * data['demand_share'][l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Aging constraints (2)
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                if t < data['periods']:
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
    
    # Waste constraints (3)
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Sales availability constraints (4)
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
    
    # Demand satisfaction with substitution
    for l in locations:
        # Basic demand: satisfied by Basic sales + substitution to Premium
        basic_demand = data['demand_curve']['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * data['demand_share'][l]
        basic_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic'] + 1))
        m.addConstr(basic_sales + S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] + lost_sales['SKU_Basic', l, t] == basic_demand, 
                   name=f"basic_demand_{l}_{t}")
        
        # Premium demand: satisfied by Premium sales minus substitution used for Basic
        premium_demand = data['demand_curve']['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * data['demand_share'][l]
        premium_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium'] + 1))
        m.addConstr(premium_sales - S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] + lost_sales['SKU_Premium', l, t] == premium_demand, 
                   name=f"premium_demand_{l}_{t}")
        
        # ShortLife demand: no substitution
        shortlife_demand = data['demand_curve']['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * data['demand_share'][l]
        shortlife_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife'] + 1))
        m.addConstr(shortlife_sales + lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife', l, t] == shortlife_demand, 
                   name=f"shortlife_demand_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Storage capacity constraints
    for l in locations:
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(
            data['cold_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= data['cold_capacity'][l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
total_cost = 0

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        total_cost += data['costs']['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                total_cost += data['costs']['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            total_cost += data['costs']['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            total_cost += data['costs']['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
T_plus = range(1, periods + 2)  # Include period T+1 for inventory tracking

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity Q[p,t]
I = {}  # Inventory I[p,l,t,r]
sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r]
S = {}  # Substitution S[basic,premium,l,t]
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales lost_sales[p,l,t]
W = {}  # Waste W[p,l,t]

# Add variables
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
    
    for l in locations:
        for t in T_plus:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
        
        for t in T:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Substitution variables (only for the specified edge)
for (p_from, p_to) in sub_edges:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            S[p_from, p_to, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"S_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Initial conditions: no inventory at start of period 1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
for p in products:
    # Production capacity constraints
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_prod_{p}_{t}")
    
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            # Fresh inflow constraint (1)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales availability constraints (4)
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Waste constraint (3)
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Aging constraints (2)
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Final period aging (to period T+1)
            if t == periods:
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, periods+1, r] == I[p, l, periods, r+1] - sales[p, l, periods, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{periods}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        # For SKU_Premium: demand must be satisfied by its own sales
        premium_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium'] + 1)) + 
                   lost_sales['SKU_Premium', l, t] == premium_demand, name=f"demand_premium_{l}_{t}")
        
        # For SKU_Basic: demand can be satisfied by its own sales or substitution from Premium
        basic_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic'] + 1)) + 
                   S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] + lost_sales['SKU_Basic', l, t] == basic_demand, name=f"demand_basic_{l}_{t}")
        
        # For SKU_ShortLife: demand must be satisfied by its own sales
        shortlife_demand = demand_curve['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife'] + 1)) + 
                   lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife', l, t] == shortlife_demand, name=f"demand_shortlife_{l}_{t}")
        
        # Substitution constraint: substitution cannot exceed available Premium inventory
        premium_available = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium'] + 1))
        total_premium_sales = premium_available + S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t]
        m.addConstr(total_premium_sales <= gp.quicksum(I['SKU_Premium', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium'] + 1)), 
                   name=f"sub_avail_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_inv = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inv <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Non-negativity constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p, l, t] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
        for t in T_plus:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, r] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_inv_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing costs
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]

# Inventory holding costs (charged on END-of-period inventory after sales, exclude r=1)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste costs
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales penalties
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

[BUSINESS DESCRIPTION]
Business narrative:
The retailer operates a category with a value-oriented basic product and a premium product that are sold under tight price bands and margin trade-offs. Premium carries higher effective margin and stricter implicit service expectations, while basic is cheaper but more price sensitive. When Basic inventory is insufficient, Basic's demand can be served by Premium (upward substitution); the reverse does not occur. Unmet demand after this limited upgrade behavior is lost and penalized.

Structure cues:
- The physical and inventory structure follows the same pattern as in retail_f1_base: single-echelon, local demand, local inventory, shared storage, and no transshipment.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
      - Charge on END-of-period inventory (after sales), exclude expiring items (r=1)
- Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]. These limits must be respected.
- The substitution graph contains a single directed edge [Basic, Premium]. This means: when Basic inventory is insufficient, Premium inventory can serve Basic's demand. S[Basic, Premium] represents units of Basic's demand fulfilled by Premium.
- Lost sales penalties and purchasing or production costs in the JSON make premium more valuable to protect and basic cheaper but more elastic. This asymmetry is expressed through cost parameters, not through any special-case constraints.
- Inventory remains non-negative; any demand that cannot be satisfied even after allowing the basic-to-premium substitution is recorded as lost sales.
- There is no transshipment, lead times are effectively zero, and labor capacity is non-binding.

```python
# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters

m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
periods = data['periods']
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create sets
T = range(1, periods + 1)
P = products
L = locations

# Create variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t]
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r]
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r]
W = {}  # W[p,l,t]
S = {}  # S[p_from,p_to,l,t] for substitution
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t]

for p in P:
    for t in T:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Substitution variables (only for the specified edge)
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            S[p_from, p_to, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"S_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in P:
    for t in T:
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# Production capacity
for p in P:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"production_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in P:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in P:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in L:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            # Add incoming substitution (from other products substituting to p)
            incoming_sub = 0
            for edge in sub_edges:
                p_from, p_to = edge
                if p_to == p:
                    incoming_sub += S[p_from, p_to, l, t]
            # Add outgoing substitution (from p substituting to other products)
            outgoing_sub = 0
            for edge in sub_edges:
                p_from, p_to = edge
                if p_from == p:
                    outgoing_sub += S[p_from, p_to, l, t]
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + incoming_sub - outgoing_sub + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand, name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Substitution constraints: S[Basic, Premium,l,t] <= available Premium inventory for substitution
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            available_premium = gp.quicksum(sales[p_to, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_to] + 1))
            # The substitution cannot exceed the remaining premium inventory after meeting its own demand
            # We need to ensure substitution doesn't exceed available premium sales capacity
            # This is handled by constraining S <= total premium sales potential minus actual premium sales
            # But a simpler approach: S <= total premium inventory available for sale
            total_premium_inv = gp.quicksum(I[p_to, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_to] + 1))
            m.addConstr(S[p_from, p_to, l, t] <= total_premium_inv, name=f"sub_avail_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in L:
    for t in T:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in P)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Non-negativity
for var in m.getVars():
    if var.VType == GRB.CONTINUOUS:
        m.addConstr(var >= 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

[BUSINESS DESCRIPTION]
Business narrative:
The retailer operates a category with a value-oriented basic product and a premium product that are sold under tight price bands and margin trade-offs. Premium carries higher effective margin and stricter implicit service expectations, while basic is cheaper but more price sensitive. When Basic inventory is insufficient, Basic's demand can be served by Premium (upward substitution); the reverse does not occur. Unmet demand after this limited upgrade behavior is lost and penalized.

Structure cues:
- The physical and inventory structure follows the same pattern as in retail_f1_base: single-echelon, local demand, local inventory, shared storage, and no transshipment.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
      - Charge on END-of-period inventory (after sales), exclude expiring items (r=1)

- The substitution graph contains a single directed edge [Basic, Premium]. This means: when Basic inventory is insufficient, Premium inventory can serve Basic's demand. S[Basic, Premium] represents units of Basic's demand fulfilled by Premium.

- Inventory remains non-negative; any demand that cannot be satisfied even after allowing the basic-to-premium substitution is recorded as lost sales.

```python
periods = data['periods']

cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory for product p, location l, period t, remaining life r
sales = {}  # Sales for product p, location l, period t, remaining life r
S = {}  # Substitution: S[basic,premium,l,t] = units of basic demand fulfilled by premium at location l in period t
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p, location l, period t
W = {}  # Waste for product p, location l, period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Substitution variables (only for the specified edge)
for (p_from, p_to) in sub_edges:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            S[p_from, p_to, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"S_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Constraints

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

# Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

# Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
# For Basic: total_sales_basic + S[Basic,Premium] + lost_sales_basic = demand_basic
# For Premium: total_sales_premium - S[Basic,Premium] + lost_sales_premium = demand_premium
# For ShortLife: total_sales_shortlife + lost_sales_shortlife = demand_shortlife
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        # Basic product
        total_sales_basic = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1))
        demand_basic = demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(total_sales_basic + S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] + lost_sales['SKU_Basic', l, t] == demand_basic)
        
        # Premium product
        total_sales_premium = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        demand_premium = demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(total_sales_premium - S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] + lost_sales['SKU_Premium', l, t] == demand_premium)
        
        # ShortLife product
        total_sales_shortlife = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife']+1))
        demand_shortlife = demand_curve['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(total_sales_shortlife + lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife', l, t] == demand_shortlife)

# Substitution constraint: S[Basic,Premium] cannot exceed available premium inventory
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_premium_inv = gp.quicksum(I['SKU_Premium', l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        m.addConstr(S['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_Premium', l, t] <= total_premium_inv)

# Initial conditions: no inventory at period 1 except fresh inflow
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL):  # All except freshest (r=SL)
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0)

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on END-of-period inventory after sales, exclude r=1)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, SL+1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

```python
# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
budget_per_period = data['constraints']['budget_per_period']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model("retail_f2_promo_budget")

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] = production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] = sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] = lost sales for product p at location l in period t
sub_sales = {}  # sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] = substitution sales from p_from to p_to at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] = waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_sales_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function: minimize total cost
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]  # Purchasing cost
        for l in locations:
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]  # Lost sales cost
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]  # Waste cost
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1):  # Holding cost for r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        for l in locations:
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,sl] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            # Add substitution sales from this product to others
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p,p_to,l,t] for p_to in products if (p,p_to) in sub_edges)
            # Add substitution sales from other products to this product
            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p_from,p,l,t] for p_from in products if (p_from,p) in sub_edges)
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_out - sub_in + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_sat_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Substitution constraints: substitution sales cannot exceed available inventory
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_avail = gp.quicksum(sales[p_from,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_from]+1)) + lost_sales[p_from,l,t]
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] <= total_avail, name=f"sub_avail_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inv = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inv <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        labor_used = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Budget constraints
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products)
    m.addConstr(purchasing_cost <= budget_per_period, name=f"budget_{t}")

# Non-negativity constraints are handled by default variable bounds

# Initial conditions: no initial inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

In the final periods of the horizon the retailer runs strong promotions on the basic and short-life products, causing their demand to spike. At the same time, an open-to-buy style budget limits how much can be spent in each period on inventory-related activities. The retailer must allocate inventory and spending over time so that promotion-induced demand is supported as well as possible without violating the budget caps.

Structure cues:
- The inventory and substitution structure is the usual single-echelon system with shared storage, production capacity, and a substitution graph, together with lost sales for unmet demand.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

```python
# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
budget_per_period = data['constraints']['budget_per_period']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
sub_sales = {}  # sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] - substitution sales from p_from to p_to at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_sales_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]
        for l in locations:
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        labor_used = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Budget constraint: purchasing spend <= budget_per_period
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    purchasing_spend = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products)
    m.addConstr(purchasing_spend <= budget_per_period)

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            # Add substitution sales where this product is the target
            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p_from,p,l,t] for p_from in products if [p_from, p] in sub_edges)
            # Subtract substitution sales where this product is the source
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p,p_to,l,t] for p_to in products if [p, p_to] in sub_edges)
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_in - sub_out + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

# Substitution constraints: substitution sales cannot exceed available inventory
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            available_for_sub = gp.quicksum(I[p_from,l,t,r] - sales[p_from,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_from]+1))
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] <= available_for_sub)

# Initial inventory: assume zero initial inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

In the final periods of the horizon the retailer runs strong promotions on the basic and short-life products, causing their demand to spike. The retailer must allocate inventory and spending over time so that promotion-induced demand is supported as well as possible without violating the budget caps.

Structure cues:

- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

```python
data = json.loads(data_str)

# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
budget_per_period = data['constraints']['budget_per_period']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
sub_sales = {}  # sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] - substitution sales from p_from to p_to at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_sales_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function: minimize total cost
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]  # purchasing cost
        obj += costs['fixed_order']  # fixed order cost (0 in this case)
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]  # lost sales cost
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]  # waste cost
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1):  # holding cost for r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Initial inventory: assume zero initial inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum over products of (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            # Add substitution sales from this product to others
            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p_from,p,l,t] for p_from in products if (p_from,p) in sub_edges)
            # Subtract substitution sales from this product to others
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p,p_to,l,t] for p_to in products if (p,p_to) in sub_edges)
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_in - sub_out + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand)

# Substitution constraints: substitution sales cannot exceed available inventory
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_available = gp.quicksum(sales[p_from,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_from]+1)) + lost_sales[p_from,l,t]
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] <= total_available)

# Budget constraint: total purchasing spend <= budget_per_period
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    total_spend = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products) + costs['fixed_order']
    m.addConstr(total_spend <= budget_per_period)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
m = gp.Model()

I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining

lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
sub_sales = {}  # sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] - substitution sales from p_from to p_to at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:

            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):

for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_sales_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity: sum over products of (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            # Add substitution sales from this product to others (as substitute)
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p,p_to,l,t] for p_to in products if (p,p_to) in sub_edges)
            # Add substitution sales from other products to this product (as substitution target)
            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p_from,p,l,t] for p_from in products if (p_from,p) in sub_edges)
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_out - sub_in + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Budget constraint: total purchasing spend <= budget_per_period
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products)
    m.addConstr(purchasing_cost <= budget_per_period, name=f"budget_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost_total = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost_total = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost_total = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost_total = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost_total + holding_cost_total + waste_cost_total + lost_sales_cost_total, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
budget_per_period = data['constraints']['budget_per_period']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create sets
T = range(1, periods + 1)
T_plus = range(1, periods + 2)  # Include period T+1 for inventory tracking

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory of product p at location l at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t from inventory with r periods remaining
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t
sub_sales = {}  # sub_sales[p_from,p_to,l,t] - substitution sales from p_from to p_to at location l in period t

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T_plus:
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_sales_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
        
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(2, sl + 1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
                
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
            
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]
            
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            if t < periods:  # t+1 exists
                for r in range(1, sl):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    sl = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_inventory = gp.QuadExpr()
        for p in products:
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                total_inventory += I[p, l, t, r]
        m.addConstr(cold_usage[p] * total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        labor_used = gp.QuadExpr()
        for p in products:
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                labor_used += labor_usage[p] * sales[p, l, t, r]
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Budget constraints
for t in T:
    purchasing_cost = gp.QuadExpr()
    for p in products:
        purchasing_cost += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
    fixed_order_cost = costs['fixed_order']  # 0 in this instance
    m.addConstr(purchasing_cost + fixed_order_cost <= budget_per_period)

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            total_sales = gp.QuadExpr()
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, sl + 1):
                total_sales += sales[p, l, t, r]
            
            # Add substitution sales to this product (from other products)
            for edge in sub_edges:
                p_from, p_to = edge
                if p_to == p:
                    total_sales += sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t]
            
            # Subtract substitution sales from this product (to other products)
            for edge in sub_edges:
                p_from, p_to = edge
                if p_from == p:
                    total_sales -= sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t]
            
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand)

# Substitution constraints: substitution sales cannot exceed available inventory
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            available_for_sub = gp.QuadExpr()
            sl_from = shelf_life[p_from]
            for r in range(1, sl_from + 1):
                available_for_sub += I[p_from, l, t, r] - sales[p_from, l, t, r]
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t] <= available_for_sub)

# Non-negativity constraints (already handled by variable bounds)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

```python
demand_share = data["demand_share"]
costs = data["costs"]

T = range(periods)

L = locations

x = m.addVars(P, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="x")  # Production quantity
I = m.addVars(P, L, range(max_age+1), T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="I")  # Inventory by age
waste = m.addVars(P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="waste")  # Waste quantity
lost_sales = m.addVars(P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="lost_sales")  # Lost sales
sub_to = m.addVars(P, P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="sub_to")  # Substitution from p to p'

for p in P:
    for t in T:

for l in L:
    for t in T:
        labor_used = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * x[p, t] for p in P)
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t])

    for t in T:
        cold_used = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, a, t] for a in range(max_age+1)) for p in P)
        m.addConstr(cold_used <= cold_capacity[l])

# Inventory balance constraints
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            # Initial inventory for t=0 (assume 0 initial inventory)
            if t == 0:
                # New production arrives (lead time 0)
                new_inv = x[p, t]
                # Age 0 inventory at start of period t
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, 0, t] == new_inv)
                # No inventory of age > 0 at start
                for a in range(1, max_age+1):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, a, t] == 0)
            else:
                # New production arrives (lead time 0)
                new_inv = x[p, t]
                # Inventory aging: age a inventory comes from age a-1 of previous period
                for a in range(1, max_age+1):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, a, t] == I[p, l, a-1, t-1])
                # Age 0 inventory is new production
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, 0, t] == new_inv)

for p in P:

            if shelf_life[p] < max_age:

                m.addConstr(waste[p, l, t] == gp.quicksum(I[p, l, a, t] for a in range(shelf_life[p]+1, max_age+1)))

            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_to[p_prime, p, l, t] for p_prime in P if [p_prime, p] in sub_edges)
            
            # Total substitution from this product
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_to[p, p_prime, l, t] for p_prime in P if [p, p_prime] in sub_edges)
            
            # Demand satisfaction constraint
            m.addConstr(available_inv + sub_in >= demand[p, l, t] + sub_out - lost_sales[p, l, t])
            
            # Cannot substitute more than available inventory
            m.addConstr(sub_out <= available_inv)

m.addConstrs(var >= 0 for var in I.values())
m.addConstrs(var >= 0 for var in waste.values())
m.addConstrs(var >= 0 for var in lost_sales.values())
m.addConstrs(var >= 0 for var in sub_to.values())

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["purchasing"][p] * x[p, t] for p in P for t in T)
inventory_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["inventory"][p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, a, t] for a in range(max_age+1)) for p in P for l in L for t in T)
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["waste"][p] * waste[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs["lost_sales"][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + inventory_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0
```

```python
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

periods = data['periods']
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

T = range(1, periods+1)
P = products
L = locations
A_max = {p: shelf_life[p] for p in P}

demand = {(p, l, t): demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l] for p in P for l in L for t in T}

x = m.addVars(P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="x")
s = m.addVars(P, L, T, range(1, max(A_max.values())+1), vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="s")
w = m.addVars(P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="w")
ls = m.addVars(P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="ls")
sub_to = m.addVars(P, P, L, T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="sub_to")

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            if t == 1:
                for a in range(1, A_max[p]+1):
                    m.addConstr(s[p, l, t, a] == 0)
            else:
                for a in range(2, A_max[p]+1):
                    m.addConstr(s[p, l, t, a] == s[p, l, t-1, a-1] - w[p, l, t-1] if a-1 <= A_max[p] else 0)
                m.addConstr(s[p, l, t, 1] == x[p, l, t-1])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(w[p, l, t] == (s[p, l, t, A_max[p]] if A_max[p] in range(1, max(A_max.values())+1) else 0))

for p in P:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[p, l, t] for l in L) <= production_cap[p][t-1])

for l in L:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * (gp.quicksum(s[p, l, t, a] for a in range(1, A_max[p]+1)) + x[p, l, t]) for p in P) <= cold_capacity[l])
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * x[p, l, t] for p in P) <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            total_served = gp.quicksum(sub_to[p_alt, p, l, t] for p_alt in P if [p_alt, p] in sub_edges or [p, p_alt] in sub_edges) + sub_to[p, p, l, t]
            m.addConstr(total_served + ls[p, l, t] == demand[p, l, t])
            m.addConstr(total_served <= gp.quicksum(s[p, l, t, a] for a in range(1, A_max[p]+1)) + x[p, l, t])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            for a in range(1, A_max[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(s[p, l, t, a] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(x[p, l, t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(w[p, l, t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(ls[p, l, t] >= 0)
            for p2 in P:
                m.addConstr(sub_to[p, p2, l, t] >= 0)

purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * x[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)
inventory_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * gp.quicksum(s[p, l, t, a] for a in range(1, A_max[p]+1)) for p in P for l in L for t in T)
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * w[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * ls[p, l, t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + inventory_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```
