# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial conditions: no initial inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            
            # Handle substitution from SKU_Basic to SKU_Premium
            if p == "SKU_Premium":
                # Premium demand can be satisfied by Basic substitution
                sub_sales = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_sales_Basic_to_Premium_{l}_{t}")
                m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_sales >= demand, name=f"demand_sat_{p}_{l}_{t}")
                
                # Substitution sales cannot exceed available Basic inventory
                if t <= periods:
                    basic_total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales["SKU_Basic",l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life["SKU_Basic"]+1))
                    basic_demand = demand_curve["SKU_Basic"][t-1] * demand_share[l]
                    basic_available = gp.quicksum(I["SKU_Basic",l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life["SKU_Basic"]+1)) - basic_total_sales
                    m.addConstr(sub_sales <= basic_available, name=f"sub_limit_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] >= demand, name=f"demand_sat_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Lead time constraints - orders placed in period t become available in period t + lead_time[p]
# This is already handled by the fresh inflow constraint which connects Q[p,t] to I[p,l,t,SL]
# but we need to ensure no inventory before lead time completes
for p in products:
    LT = lead_time[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, min(LT, periods)+1):
            # No inventory from production before lead time completes
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == 0, name=f"lead_time_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) 
                          for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) 
                          for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))  # r >= 2
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:

Business narrative:
Orders for each product take several periods to arrive. When the retailer places an order, the goods travel in a pipeline and only become available to serve demand after a deterministic lead time that is specific to each product. Demand is local and exogenous; customers are never backordered, so demand that cannot be met by on-hand inventory in a period is lost and penalized.

Structure cues:
- The inventory system is single-echelon with ordering decisions, storage capacity, and lost sales.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t

            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Output

if m.Status == 2:

            # Sales of p_to cannot exceed its own demand plus substitution from p_from

            m.addConstr(total_sales_to <= demand_curve[p_to][t-1] * demand_share[l] + lost_sales[p_from,l,t])

# (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
# This is implemented in the objective function

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(
            cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Production capacity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Labor capacity constraints (though labor_usage is 0 for all products)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(
            labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            for p in products
        )
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Lead time constraints - orders placed in period t become available in period t + lead_time[p]
# This is handled by the fresh inflow constraint which sets I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
# We need to ensure that Q[p,t] is only used when t > lead_time[p] for initial periods
# Initialize inventory for periods before lead time completes
for p in products:
    LT = lead_time[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, LT+1):
            # For periods before lead time completes, no production can have arrived yet
            # So initial inventory must be 0 for all remaining life values
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] == 0)

# Non-negativity constraints are handled by variable bounds

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, SL+1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]

# Fixed order cost (0 in this instance)
# Transshipment cost (0 in this instance)

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        # SKU_Basic demand
        total_basic_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1))
        m.addConstr(total_basic_sales + lost_sales['SKU_Basic',l,t] == demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l], 
                   name=f"demand_basic_{l}_{t}")
        
        # SKU_Premium demand with substitution from SKU_Basic
        total_premium_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        substitution = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sub_{l}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(total_premium_sales + substitution + lost_sales['SKU_Premium',l,t] == demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l], 
                   name=f"demand_premium_{l}_{t}")
        # Substitution constraint: substitution cannot exceed available SKU_Basic inventory after meeting its own demand
        basic_avail_after_demand = gp.quicksum(I['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1)) - total_basic_sales
        m.addConstr(substitution <= basic_avail_after_demand, name=f"sub_limit_{l}_{t}")
        
        # SKU_ShortLife demand
        total_shortlife_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife']+1))
        m.addConstr(total_shortlife_sales + lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t] == demand_curve['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * demand_share[l], 
                   name=f"demand_shortlife_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Lead time constraints - orders placed in period t become available in period t + lead_time[p]
# This is handled by the fresh inflow constraint which connects Q[p,t] to I[p,l,t,SL]
# We need to ensure that for t <= lead_time[p], Q[p,t] = 0 since orders placed before period 1 don't exist
for p in products:
    LT = lead_time[p]
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        if t <= LT:
            m.addConstr(Q[p,t] == 0, name=f"lead_time_{p}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) 
                          for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) 
                          for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))  # r >= 2
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
moq = data['constraints']['moq']

# Variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - total production for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t
order_binary = {}  # Binary variable for MOQ: 1 if order placed, 0 otherwise

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        order_binary[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"order_binary_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        obj += data['costs']['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]
        obj += data['costs']['fixed_order'] * order_binary[p,t]
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            obj += data['costs']['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]
            obj += data['costs']['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]
            SL = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(2, SL + 1):  # r >= 2
                obj += data['costs']['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# MOQ constraint: Q[p,t] >= moq * order_binary[p,t] and Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1] * order_binary[p,t]
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= moq * order_binary[p,t])
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= data['production_cap'][p][t-1] * order_binary[p,t])

# Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * data['demand_share'][l])

# Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            if t < data['periods']:
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

# Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == data['demand_curve'][p][t-1] * data['demand_share'][l])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(data['cold_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= data['cold_capacity'][l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * sum_r sales[p,l,t,r]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(data['labor_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= data['labor_cap'][l][t-1])

# Substitution constraint: SKU_Basic can substitute for SKU_Premium
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        premium_demand = data['demand_curve']['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * data['demand_share'][l]
        basic_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic'] + 1))
        premium_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium'] + 1))
        m.addConstr(basic_sales + premium_sales >= premium_demand)

# Initial inventory: zero at start of period 1 for all products, locations, and remaining lives
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

Business narrative:
The retailer faces a minimum order quantity applied uniformly across the category. In any period, the buyer must either place no order for a product or place an order that is at least as large as the specified global minimum. It is never allowed to place a small positive order below that threshold. This creates an all-or-nothing structure in procurement decisions on top of the usual inventory and storage logic.

Structure cues:
- The system is single-echelon with ordering decisions, storage capacity, and lost sales.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]

    "transshipment": 0.5,
    "purchasing": {
      "SKU_Basic": 10.0,
      "SKU_Premium": 20.0,
      "SKU_ShortLife": 15.0
    }
  },
  "constraints": {
    "moq": 300,
    "pack_size": 1,
    "budget_per_period": null,
    "waste_limit_pct": null
  },
  "network": {
    "sub_edges": [
      [
        "SKU_Basic",
        "SKU_Premium"
      ]
    ],
    "trans_edges": []
  }
}
"""
data = json.loads(data_str)

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
lead_time = data['lead_time']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
return_rate = data['return_rate']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
constraints = data['constraints']
network = data['network']

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - total production for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t
order_binary = {}  # Binary variable for MOQ: 1 if order placed, 0 otherwise

# Add variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        order_binary[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"order_binary_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial conditions: no inventory at period 1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
# This is implemented in the objective function

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# MOQ constraint: Q[p,t] must be 0 or >= moq
moq = constraints['moq']
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= moq * order_binary[p,t], name=f"moq_lower_{p}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1] * order_binary[p,t], name=f"moq_upper_{p}_{t}")

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Labor capacity (generous, but still modeled)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        labor_used = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
# Network has sub_edges: SKU_Basic can substitute for SKU_Premium
# Total sales across products that can satisfy demand must meet demand minus lost sales
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        # SKU_Premium demand can be satisfied by SKU_Premium or SKU_Basic
        premium_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        premium_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        basic_sales_for_premium = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1))
        m.addConstr(premium_sales + basic_sales_for_premium + lost_sales['SKU_Premium',l,t] == premium_demand, name=f"demand_premium_{l}_{t}")
        
        # SKU_Basic demand can only be satisfied by SKU_Basic
        basic_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        basic_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1))
        m.addConstr(basic_sales + lost_sales['SKU_Basic',l,t] == basic_demand, name=f"demand_basic_{l}_{t}")
        
        # SKU_ShortLife demand can only be satisfied by SKU_ShortLife
        shortlife_demand = demand_curve['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        shortlife_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife']+1))
        m.addConstr(shortlife_sales + lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t] == shortlife_demand, name=f"demand_shortlife_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, SL+1):
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]

# Fixed order cost (0 in this case, but included for completeness)
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['fixed_order'] * order_binary[p,t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
```

Business narrative:
The retailer faces a minimum order quantity applied uniformly across the category. In any period, the buyer must either place no order for a product or place an order that is at least as large as the specified global minimum. It is never allowed to place a small positive order below that threshold. This creates an all-or-nothing structure in procurement decisions on top of the usual inventory and storage logic.

Structure cues:
- The system is single-echelon with ordering decisions, storage capacity, and lost sales.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

data = json.loads(data_str)

m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
costs = data['costs']
moq = data['constraints']['moq']

T = range(1, periods+1)
P = products
L = locations

I = {}
sales = {}
lost_sales = {}
Q = {}
W = {}
for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

binary_Q = {}
for p in P:
    for t in T:
        binary_Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"binary_Q_{p}_{t}")

m.update()

for p in P:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= moq * binary_Q[p,t])
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1] * binary_Q[p,t])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand)

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,sl] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

for p in P:
    for l in L:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

for l in L:
    for t in T:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in P)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

for l in L:
    for t in T:
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in P)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in P for t in T)
inventory_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for p in P for l in L for t in T for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in P for l in L for t in T)

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + inventory_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

m.optimize()

print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

[SCENARIO]
Family: F6 (Logistics and Integer Procurement)
Archetype: retail_f6_moq_binary
Scenario ID: retail_f6_moq_binary_v3

[BUSINESS DESCRIPTION]
Business narrative:
The retailer faces a minimum order quantity applied uniformly across the category. In any period, the buyer must either place no order for a product or place an order that is at least as large as the specified global minimum. It is never allowed to place a small positive order below that threshold. This creates an all-or-nothing structure in procurement decisions on top of the usual inventory and storage logic.

Structure cues:
- The system is single-echelon with ordering decisions, storage capacity, and lost sales.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!
      - Q is total production, demand_share distributes it to locations.

  (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

  (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

  (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
      - Can only sell what you have in inventory

  (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
      - Charge on END-of-period inventory (after sales), exclude expiring items (r=1)
- Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]. These limits must be respected.
- The JSON specifies moq=300 in the "constraints" object. For each product, location, and period, the order quantity must either be zero or at least 300; intermediate positive quantities below moq are forbidden.
- This all-or-nothing pattern must be enforced consistently across products, locations, and periods so that the model does not exploit fractional orders below the global minimum.
- Inventory balance follows the standard pattern with zero lead time: on-hand stock in a period comes from previous stock and current orders, minus sales and waste, and cannot become negative.
- There is no transshipment; substitution behavior follows the JSON graph, and labor capacity is generous.

cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
return_rate = data['return_rate']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
constraints = data['constraints']
network = data['network']

moq = constraints['moq']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - total production for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales for product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t
binary_Q = {}  # binary_Q[p,t] - binary variable for MOQ constraint

# Add variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        binary_Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"binary_Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Set objective
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]

    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, SL+1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l])

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.QuadExpr()
        for p in products:
            SL = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                total_inventory += cold_usage[p] * I[p,l,t,r]
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l])

# MOQ constraint: Q[p,t] must be 0 or >= moq
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= moq * binary_Q[p,t])
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1] * binary_Q[p,t])

# Production capacity constraint
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Labor capacity constraint (generous, but included for completeness)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        labor_used = gp.QuadExpr()
        for p in products:
            SL = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                labor_used += labor_usage[p] * sales[p,l,t,r]
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
# From network: SKU_Basic can substitute for SKU_Premium
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        # SKU_Premium demand
        premium_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        premium_sales = gp.QuadExpr()
        SL_premium = shelf_life['SKU_Premium']
        for r in range(1, SL_premium+1):
            premium_sales += sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r]
        basic_sales_sub = gp.QuadExpr()
        SL_basic = shelf_life['SKU_Basic']
        for r in range(1, SL_basic+1):
            basic_sales_sub += sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r]
        # Total sales of Premium + substitution from Basic should meet demand
        m.addConstr(premium_sales + basic_sales_sub + lost_sales['SKU_Premium',l,t] >= premium_demand)
        # But substitution cannot exceed available Basic inventory beyond its own demand
        basic_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(basic_sales_sub <= basic_demand + lost_sales['SKU_Basic',l,t])  # Basic can only substitute excess

# Demand for other products without substitution
for p in ['SKU_Basic', 'SKU_ShortLife']:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            total_sales = gp.QuadExpr()
            SL = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                total_sales += sales[p,l,t,r]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] >= demand)

# Non-negativity constraints
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p,l,t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] >= 0)
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] >= 0)

# Initial inventory: assume zero initial inventory
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Solve model
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

Business narrative:
The retailer faces a minimum order quantity applied uniformly across the category. In any period, the buyer must either place no order for a product or place an order that is at least as large as the specified global minimum. It is never allowed to place a small positive order below that threshold. This creates an all-or-nothing structure in procurement decisions on top of the usual inventory and storage logic.

Structure cues:
- The system is single-echelon with ordering decisions, storage capacity, and lost sales.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

  (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]

m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
lead_time = data['lead_time']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
return_rate = data['return_rate']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
constraints = data['constraints']
network = data['network']

moq = constraints['moq']

# Create variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t
order_binary = {}  # Binary variable for MOQ: 1 if order placed, 0 otherwise

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        order_binary[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"order_binary_{p}_{t}")
        
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Set initial conditions (no initial inventory)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"initial_inventory_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Add constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        # Production capacity constraint
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"production_cap_{p}_{t}")
        
        # MOQ constraint: Q[p,t] >= moq * order_binary[p,t]
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= moq * order_binary[p,t], name=f"moq_lower_{p}_{t}")
        
        # MOQ constraint: Q[p,t] <= M * order_binary[p,t] (where M is large enough)
        M = production_cap[p][t-1]  # Use production cap as big M
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= M * order_binary[p,t], name=f"moq_upper_{p}_{t}")
        
        for l in locations:
            # Fresh inflow constraint (1)
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Sales availability constraint (4)
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_availability_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            # Demand satisfaction with substitution
            # First, calculate total potential demand for this product-location-period
            total_demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            
            # For substitution: SKU_Basic can substitute for SKU_Premium
            if p == "SKU_Premium":
                # Premium demand can be satisfied by Premium sales or Basic substitution
                basic_substitution = gp.quicksum(sales["SKU_Basic",l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life["SKU_Basic"]+1))
                m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) + basic_substitution + lost_sales[p,l,t] == total_demand,
                           name=f"demand_satisfaction_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            else:
                # Regular demand satisfaction
                m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) + lost_sales[p,l,t] == total_demand,
                           name=f"demand_satisfaction_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Waste constraint (3)
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            
            # Aging constraints (2) for next period
            if t < periods:
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], 
                               name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                
                # For the freshest inventory in next period (handled by fresh inflow constraint)
                # Items that would age beyond shelf life become waste (already handled)
            
            # Non-negativity constraints
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p,l,t] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] >= 0, name=f"nonneg_W_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity constraints
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) 
                                    for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_capacity_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity constraints (generous, but included for completeness)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        labor_used = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) 
                               for p in products)
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_capacity_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1):
                # End-of-period inventory = I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
pack_size = data['constraints']['pack_size']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - total production for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

m.update()

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        # For SKU_Premium: total sales + lost_sales = demand
        p_premium = "SKU_Premium"
        demand_premium = demand_curve[p_premium][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p_premium,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_premium]+1)) + lost_sales[p_premium,l,t] == demand_premium)
        
        # For SKU_Basic: total sales + lost_sales = demand + substitution from SKU_Premium
        p_basic = "SKU_Basic"
        demand_basic = demand_curve[p_basic][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        # Allow substitution: if SKU_Premium has lost sales, SKU_Basic can fulfill that demand
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p_basic,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_basic]+1)) + lost_sales[p_basic,l,t] == demand_basic + lost_sales[p_premium,l,t])
        
        # For SKU_ShortLife: total sales + lost_sales = demand
        p_short = "SKU_ShortLife"
        demand_short = demand_curve[p_short][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p_short,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_short]+1)) + lost_sales[p_short,l,t] == demand_short)

# (5) Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
# This is implemented in the objective function

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_inventory = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inventory <= cold_capacity[l])

# Pack size constraint: Q[p,t] must be multiple of pack_size
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] % pack_size == 0)

# Production capacity constraint
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Non-negativity constraints
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p,l,t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] >= 0)

# Initial inventory: assume zero initial inventory
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()

# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, SL+1):
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])

# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]

# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

Structure cues:

- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

cold_usage = data['cold_usage']

demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
pack_size = data['constraints']['pack_size']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - total production for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial inventory (assume zero)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    # Production capacity
    for p in products:
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
    
    # Pack size constraint
    for p in products:
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] % pack_size == 0, name=f"pack_size_{p}_{t}")
    
    # Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
    
    # Demand satisfaction with substitution
    for l in locations:
        # SKU_Basic demand
        total_basic_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1))
        total_premium_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        basic_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(total_basic_sales + total_premium_sales + lost_sales['SKU_Basic',l,t] >= basic_demand, name=f"demand_basic_{l}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(total_basic_sales + total_premium_sales <= basic_demand, name=f"demand_basic_upper_{l}_{t}")
        
        # SKU_Premium demand
        premium_demand = demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(total_premium_sales + lost_sales['SKU_Premium',l,t] >= premium_demand, name=f"demand_premium_{l}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(total_premium_sales <= premium_demand, name=f"demand_premium_upper_{l}_{t}")
        
        # SKU_ShortLife demand
        total_shortlife_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife']+1))
        shortlife_demand = demand_curve['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        m.addConstr(total_shortlife_sales + lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t] >= shortlife_demand, name=f"demand_shortlife_{l}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(total_shortlife_sales <= shortlife_demand, name=f"demand_shortlife_upper_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Inventory balance for next period
    if t < periods:
        for p in products:
            for l in locations:
                # Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                # For r = shelf_life[p], it's set by fresh inflow constraint above
    
    # Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
    for l in locations:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

Structure cues:

- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
pack_size = data['constraints']['pack_size']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - total production for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial conditions: no initial inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

# Constraints
# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            # Check for substitution edges
            sub_demand = demand
            for edge in sub_edges:
                if p == edge[1]:  # This product can be substituted by the other
                    sub_product = edge[0]
                    sub_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[sub_product,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[sub_product]+1))
                    sub_demand -= min(sub_sales, demand_curve[sub_product][t-1] * demand_share[l] - gp.quicksum(sales[sub_product,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[sub_product]+1)))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] >= sub_demand)
            m.addConstr(total_sales <= sub_demand)

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Pack size constraint
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] % pack_size == 0)

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity (though labor_usage is 0 for all products)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(costs['labor_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= data['labor_cap'][l][t-1])

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

data = json.loads(data_str)

# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
pack_size = data['constraints']['pack_size']
sub_edges = data['network']['sub_edges']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial conditions: no initial inventory
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    # Production capacity constraints
    for p in products:
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")
        # Pack size constraint
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] % pack_size == 0, name=f"pack_size_{p}_{t}")
    
    # Fresh inflow constraint (1)
    for p in products:
        SL = shelf_life[p]
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Sales availability constraints (4)
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
    
    # Demand satisfaction with substitution
    for l in locations:
        # For SKU_Basic: demand can be satisfied by SKU_Basic or SKU_Premium
        total_demand_basic = demand_curve['SKU_Basic'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        basic_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Basic',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Basic']+1))
        premium_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        m.addConstr(basic_sales + premium_sales + lost_sales['SKU_Basic',l,t] == total_demand_basic, 
                   name=f"demand_basic_{l}_{t}")
        
        # For SKU_Premium: demand can only be satisfied by SKU_Premium
        total_demand_premium = demand_curve['SKU_Premium'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        premium_sales_only = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_Premium',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_Premium']+1))
        m.addConstr(premium_sales_only + lost_sales['SKU_Premium',l,t] == total_demand_premium, 
                   name=f"demand_premium_{l}_{t}")
        
        # For SKU_ShortLife: demand can only be satisfied by SKU_ShortLife
        total_demand_short = demand_curve['SKU_ShortLife'][t-1] * demand_share[l]
        short_sales = gp.quicksum(sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life['SKU_ShortLife']+1))
        m.addConstr(short_sales + lost_sales['SKU_ShortLife',l,t] == total_demand_short, 
                   name=f"demand_short_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Waste constraint (3)
    for p in products:
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Storage capacity constraint
    for l in locations:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) 
                                for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")
    
    # Aging constraints (2) - for next period
    if t < periods:
        for p in products:
            for l in locations:
                for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                    m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], 
                               name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) 
                          for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) 
                          for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

lead_time = data['lead_time']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
return_rate = data['return_rate']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']
constraints = data['constraints']
network = data['network']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Q[p,t] - production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # I[p,l,t,r] - inventory at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # sales[p,l,t,r] - sales of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # lost_sales[p,l,t] - lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # W[p,l,t] - waste for product p at location l in period t

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial inventory (assume zero initial inventory)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,shelf_life[p]] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products) <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Budget constraint: sum_p (Q[p,t] * costs['purchasing'][p]) <= constraints['budget_per_period']
for t in range(1, periods+1):
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(Q[p,t] * costs['purchasing'][p] for p in products) <= constraints['budget_per_period'], name=f"budget_{t}")

# Non-negativity constraints are handled by variable bounds

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += Q[p,t] * costs['purchasing'][p]
# Inventory holding cost (charged on END-of-period inventory after sales, exclude r=1)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1):
                obj += (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) * costs['inventory'][p]
# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += W[p,l,t] * costs['waste'][p]
# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += lost_sales[p,l,t] * costs['lost_sales'][p]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")
