    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0)

# Constraints
# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products) <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * units_handled[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
# Units handled: total inventory at start of period (sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) represents units to handle
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products) <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
# Purchasing cost
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
# Inventory holding cost: charged on (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) for r >= 2
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
# Waste cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

m = gp.Model()

m.Params.Seed = 0

I = {}  # Inventory for product p, location l, period t, remaining life r
sales = {}  # Sales for product p, location l, period t, remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p, location l, period t
W = {}  # Waste for product p, location l, period t

for p in products:

        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")

            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]

                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * units_handled[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
# Units handled: total inflow + total sales (simplified as per problem description)
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * (Q[p, t] * demand_share[l] + gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Non-negativity constraints
for var in m.getVars():
    m.addConstr(var >= 0)

data = json.loads(data_str)

# Extract data
products = data['products']
locations = data['locations']
periods = data['periods']
shelf_life = data['shelf_life']
cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory for product p, location l, period t, remaining life r
sales = {}  # Sales for product p, location l, period t, remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p, location l, period t
W = {}  # Waste for product p, location l, period t

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Add initial inventory constraints (assume zero initial inventory)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0)

# Constraints
for t in range(1, periods + 1):
    # Production capacity constraints
    for p in products:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] >= 0)
    
    for l in locations:
        # Fresh inflow constraint (1)
        for p in products:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])
        
        # Aging constraints (2)
        for p in products:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                if t < periods:
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])
        
        # Waste constraints (3)
        for p in products:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])
        
        # Sales availability constraints (4)
        for p in products:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])
        
        # Demand satisfaction constraints
        for p in products:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])
        
        # Storage capacity constraints
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])
        
        # Labor capacity constraints
        units_handled = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * (Q[p, t] * demand_share[l] + gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(units_handled <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1) for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1))

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

demand_share = data['demand_share']

T = range(1, periods + 1)
T_plus = range(1, periods + 2)  # Include period T+1 for terminal inventory

# Create variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory I[p,l,t,r] at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r] of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # Waste W[p,l,t] for product p at location l in period t

# Production variables
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")

# Inventory variables (r=1 is oldest, r=SL is freshest)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T_plus:
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):

        for t in T:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Waste variables
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Set objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
# Purchasing cost
for p in products:

# Inventory holding cost (charged on end-of-period inventory for r >= 2)
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
# Lost sales cost
for p in products:
    for l in locations:

            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            if t < periods:  # t+1 exists
                for r in range(1, SL):
                    m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
# total_inventory[p,l,t] = sum_r I[p,l,t,r] (at start of period)
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * units_handled[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
# units_handled = total inflow + total sales? Problem says "volume of units handled, such as sum of units received, picked, or moved"
# Since we have receiving (inflow) and picking (sales), we'll use: units_handled = inflow + sales
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * (Q[p, t] * demand_share[l] + gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Non-negativity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] >= 0)
    for l in locations:
        for t in T_plus:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, r] >= 0)
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p, l, t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] >= 0)
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] >= 0)

# Initial inventory: I[p,l,1,r] = 0 for all p, l, r (no initial inventory)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Print results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
return_rate = data['return_rate']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory I[p,l,t,r]
sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r]
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # Waste W[p,l,t]

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Objective function
obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t]
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r])
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            sl = shelf_life[p]
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,sl] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
# Plus returns: add return_rate[p] * total_sales[p,l,t-1] to I[p,l,t,1] for t>=2
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
        # Handle returns for t>=2: add to I[p,l,t,1]
        for t in range(2, periods+1):
            total_sales_prev = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t-1,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,1] == I[p,l,t,1] + return_rate[p] * total_sales_prev, name=f"returns_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Non-negativity
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p,l,t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] >= 0)
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

m = gp.Model()

sales = {}  # Sales of product p, location l, period t, remaining life r

        for l in locations:

            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")

            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]

                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, sl] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):

for p in products:

        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            total_sales_t = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            returns = return_rate[p] * total_sales_t
            # Returns enter as age-1 inventory in next period
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, 1] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1] - W[p, l, t] + returns)

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Non-negativity
for var in m.getVars():
    m.addConstr(var >= 0)

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

m.optimize()

            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t]

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * sum_r I[p,l,t,r]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * sum_r sales[p,l,t,r]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Non-negativity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] >= 0)
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p,l,t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] >= 0)
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,r] >= 0)
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] >= 0)

# Initial inventory: all zero at t=1 for r < shelf_life (only fresh inventory at start)
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0)

for p in products:

            SL = shelf_life[p]

            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

for p in products:

for l in locations:

    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            total_sales_prev = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            returns = return_rate[p] * total_sales_prev

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Non-negativity
for var in m.getVars():
    m.addConstr(var >= 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

Storage capacity and labor capacity at stores are scaled up, but labor usage per unit is higher when stores serve both channels. Demand from walk-in and online customers is aggregated into a single local demand stream per product and location, and unmet demand is lost and penalized.

Structure cues:
- The inventory structure is single-echelon with local demand at each location, storage capacity, and lost sales.
- Shelf life: Each product has a shelf life in periods. Inventory must be tracked by REMAINING LIFE.

  VARIABLE DEFINITION: I[p,l,t,r] = inventory at START of period t with r periods remaining.
  Convention: r=1 is OLDEST (sell first FIFO), r=shelf_life[p] is FRESHEST.

  KEY EQUATIONS - implement EXACTLY as written, do NOT add or remove terms:

      - This is ONLY the inflow from production. Do NOT subtract sales here!

      - Inventory tomorrow with r remaining = inventory today with r+1 remaining - sales

      - Items with r=1 that aren't sold become waste

sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r] of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r

                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, T):

                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

for p in products:

            m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) + lost_sales[p, l, t] == total_demand)

        m.addConstr(total_inv <= data['cold_capacity'][l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l,t]
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(data['labor_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= data['labor_cap'][l][t-1])

# Non-negativity
for v in m.getVars():
    m.addConstr(v >= 0)

purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in periods)
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in periods for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(data['costs']['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")

    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']

# Create model
m = gp.Model()
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory I[p,l,t,r]
sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r]
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # Waste W[p,l,t]

for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            lost_sales[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p,l,t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                I[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p,l,t,r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Initial inventory: assume zero initial inventory
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, SL+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,1,r] == 0, name=f"init_inv_{p}_{l}_{r}")

# Constraints
# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p,l,t,SL] == Q[p,t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p,l,t+1,r] == I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(W[p,l,t] == I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, SL+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p,l,t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], 
                       name=f"demand_sat_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1], name=f"prod_cap_{p}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) 
                                    for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_labor_usage = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p,l,t,r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) 
                                     for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor_usage <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p,t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p,l,t,r] - sales[p,l,t,r]) 
                          for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) 
                          for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * W[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p,l,t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

total_cost = purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost
m.setObjective(total_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

cold_capacity = data['cold_capacity']
cold_usage = data['cold_usage']
production_cap = data['production_cap']
labor_cap = data['labor_cap']
labor_usage = data['labor_usage']
demand_curve = data['demand_curve']
demand_share = data['demand_share']
costs = data['costs']

T_plus = range(1, periods + 2)  # Include period T+1 for inventory tracking

Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory I[p,l,t,r] at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r] of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t

            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):

        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
        
    for l in locations:

            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
            
            # Inventory holding cost on end-of-period inventory (after sales) for r >= 2
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:

        for t in T:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in T:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l])

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in T:
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= labor_cap[l][t-1])

# Non-negativity constraints
for p in products:
    for t in T:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] >= 0)
        
    for l in locations:
        for t in T_plus:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, r] >= 0)
        
        for t in T:
            m.addConstr(lost_sales[p, l, t] >= 0)
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] >= 0)
            
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] >= 0)

# Initial inventory: I[p,l,1,r] = 0 for all p, l, r
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, 1, r] == 0)

m.optimize()

shelf_life = data['shelf_life']

# Variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory I[p,l,t,r] at start of period t with r periods remaining
sales = {}  # Sales sales[p,l,t,r] of product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # Waste W[p,l,t] for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        for l in locations:
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
                sales[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"sales_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

obj = gp.QuadExpr()
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        obj += data['costs']['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
        for l in locations:
            obj += data['costs']['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]
            obj += data['costs']['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):  # Holding cost for r >= 2
                obj += data['costs']['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])
m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints

# (1) Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for t in periods:
        for l in locations:
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * data['demand_share'][l])

# (2) Aging: I[p,l,t+1,r] = I[p,l,t,r+1] - sales[p,l,t,r+1] for r=1..SL-1
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            if t < data['periods']:

# (3) Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# (4) Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):

# Demand satisfaction: sum_r sales[p,l,t,r] + lost_sales[p,l,t] = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == data['demand_curve'][p][t-1] * data['demand_share'][l])

# Production capacity: Q[p,t] <= production_cap[p][t-1]
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= data['production_cap'][p][t-1])

# Storage capacity: sum_p (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_inv = gp.quicksum(data['cold_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_inv <= data['cold_capacity'][l])

# Labor capacity: sum_p (labor_usage[p] * total_sales[p,l,t]) <= labor_cap[l][t-1]
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_labor = gp.quicksum(data['labor_usage'][p] * gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_labor <= data['labor_cap'][l][t-1])

# Non-negativity
for var in m.getVars():
    if var.VType == GRB.CONTINUOUS:
        m.addConstr(var >= 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

# Create model
m = gp.Model()

m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Decision variables
Q = {}  # Production quantity for product p in period t
I = {}  # Inventory for product p at location l at start of period t with remaining life r
sales = {}  # Sales for product p at location l in period t with remaining life r
waste = {}  # Waste for product p at location l in period t
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t
sub_sales = {}  # Substitution sales: sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t]

# Initialize variables
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        Q[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Q_{p}_{t}")
        
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            waste[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"LS_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):

    for l in locations:

            sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Sub_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Constraints

# Production capacity
for p in products:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        m.addConstr(Q[p, t] <= production_cap[p][t-1])

# Fresh inflow: I[p,l,t,SL] = Q[p,t] * demand_share[l]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, shelf_life[p]] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l])

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1])

# Waste: W[p,l,t] = I[p,l,t,1] - sales[p,l,t,1]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            m.addConstr(waste[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1))
            # Add substitution sales from this product to others
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p, p_to, l, t] for p_to in products if [p, p_to] in sub_edges)
            # Add substitution sales from other products to this one
            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p_from, p, l, t] for p_from in products if [p_from, p] in sub_edges)
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_out - sub_in + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand)

# Substitution constraints: can only substitute if inventory available
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods+1):
            total_avail = gp.quicksum(I[p_from, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_from]+1))
            total_sales_p_from = gp.quicksum(sales[p_from, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_from]+1))
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t] <= total_avail - total_sales_p_from)

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods+1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p]+1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Waste limit: sum(waste) <= waste_limit_pct * sum(demand)
total_waste = gp.quicksum(waste[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
total_demand = gp.quicksum(demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
m.addConstr(total_waste <= waste_limit_pct * total_demand)

# Non-negativity
for var in [Q, I, sales, waste, lost_sales, sub_sales]:
    for key in var:
        m.addConstr(var[key] >= 0)

# Objective function
purchasing_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))
holding_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r]) for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1) for r in range(2, shelf_life[p]+1))
waste_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['waste'][p] * waste[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))
lost_sales_cost = gp.quicksum(costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods+1))

m.setObjective(purchasing_cost + holding_cost + waste_cost + lost_sales_cost, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
if m.Status == 2:
    print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

            if not substitute_available:

total_demand = sum(demand_curve[p][t-1] for p in products for t in range(1, periods+1))

lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t

            obj += costs['waste'][p] * waste[p, l, t]

    for l in locations:

    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            m.addConstr(waste[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1])

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r])

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            incoming_sub = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p2, p, l, t] for p2 in products if [p2, p] in sub_edges)
            outgoing_sub = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p, p2, l, t] for p2 in products if [p, p2] in sub_edges)
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + incoming_sub - outgoing_sub + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand)

# Substitution sales cannot exceed available inventory
for edge in sub_edges:
    p, p2 = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in periods:
            available_for_sub = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) - gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p, p3, l, t] for p3 in products if [p, p3] in sub_edges)
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p, p2, l, t] <= available_for_sub)

# Storage capacity
for l in locations:
    for t in periods:
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l])

# Waste limit: sum(waste) <= waste_limit_pct * sum(demand)
total_waste = gp.quicksum(waste[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in periods)
total_demand = sum(demand_curve[p][t-1] for p in products for t in periods)
m.addConstr(total_waste <= waste_limit_pct * total_demand)

# Non-negativity
for var in m.getVars():
    m.addConstr(var >= 0)

# Solve
m.optimize()

# Output

lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p, location l, period t

sub_sales = {}  # Substitution sales from p to p' at location l, period t

obj = gp.QuadExpr()

        for l in locations:

            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
            for r in range(2, shelf_life[p] + 1):  # r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

    for l in locations:

            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            # Add substitution sales to this product from other products
            sub_in = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p_from, p, l, t] for p_from in products if [p_from, p] in sub_edges)
            # Subtract substitution sales from this product to other products
            sub_out = gp.quicksum(sub_sales[p, p_to, l, t] for p_to in products if [p, p_to] in sub_edges)
            demand = demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l]
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_in - sub_out + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand, name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Substitution constraints: substitution sales cannot exceed available inventory
for edge in sub_edges:
    p_from, p_to = edge
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_avail = gp.quicksum(sales[p_from, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p_from] + 1)) + lost_sales[p_from, l, t]
            m.addConstr(sub_sales[p_from, p_to, l, t] <= total_avail, name=f"sub_avail_{p_from}_{p_to}_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Waste limit: sum(waste) <= waste_limit_pct * sum(demand)
total_waste = gp.quicksum(W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1))
total_demand = gp.quicksum(demand_curve[p][t-1] for p in products for t in range(1, periods + 1))
m.addConstr(total_waste <= waste_limit_pct * total_demand, name="waste_limit")

# Non-negativity constraints are implicit in variable definitions

# Set parameters
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0
m.Params.Threads = 1
m.Params.Seed = 0

# Solve
m.optimize()

m.Params.Seed = 0

sales = {}  # Sales for product p at location l in period t from inventory with remaining life r
lost_sales = {}  # Lost sales for product p at location l in period t
W = {}  # Waste for product p at location l in period t

for p in products:

    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                I[p, l, t, r] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"I_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")
            lost_sales[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"lost_sales_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            W[p, l, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"W_{p}_{l}_{t}")
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):

    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        obj += costs['purchasing'][p] * Q[p, t]
        for l in locations:
            obj += costs['lost_sales'][p] * lost_sales[p, l, t]
            obj += costs['waste'][p] * W[p, l, t]
            SL = shelf_life[p]
            for r in range(2, SL + 1):  # Holding cost for r >= 2
                obj += costs['inventory'][p] * (I[p, l, t, r] - sales[p, l, t, r])

    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        labor_used = gp.quicksum(labor_usage[p] * Q[p, t] * demand_share[l] for p in products)
        m.addConstr(labor_used <= labor_cap[l][t-1], name=f"labor_cap_{l}_{t}")

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(I[p, l, t, SL] == Q[p, t] * demand_share[l], name=f"fresh_inflow_{p}_{l}_{t}")

for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods):
            for r in range(1, SL):
                m.addConstr(I[p, l, t+1, r] == I[p, l, t, r+1] - sales[p, l, t, r+1], name=f"aging_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            m.addConstr(W[p, l, t] == I[p, l, t, 1] - sales[p, l, t, 1], name=f"waste_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Sales availability: sales[p,l,t,r] <= I[p,l,t,r]
for p in products:
    SL = shelf_life[p]
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            for r in range(1, SL + 1):
                m.addConstr(sales[p, l, t, r] <= I[p, l, t, r], name=f"sales_avail_{p}_{l}_{t}_{r}")

# Demand satisfaction with substitution
for p in products:
    for l in locations:
        for t in range(1, periods + 1):
            total_sales = gp.quicksum(sales[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1))
            # Add substitution from Basic to Premium if applicable
            sub_sales = 0
            for edge in sub_edges:
                if p == edge[1]:  # If this product can be substituted by another
                    sub_from = edge[0]
                    sub_sales += gp.quicksum(sales[sub_from, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[sub_from] + 1))
            m.addConstr(total_sales + sub_sales + lost_sales[p, l, t] == demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l], name=f"demand_{p}_{l}_{t}")

# Storage capacity: sum over products of (cold_usage[p] * total_inventory[p,l,t]) <= cold_capacity[l]
for l in locations:
    for t in range(1, periods + 1):
        total_cold_usage = gp.quicksum(cold_usage[p] * gp.quicksum(I[p, l, t, r] for r in range(1, shelf_life[p] + 1)) for p in products)
        m.addConstr(total_cold_usage <= cold_capacity[l], name=f"storage_cap_{l}_{t}")

# Waste limit: sum(waste) <= waste_limit_pct * sum(demand)
total_waste = gp.quicksum(W[p, l, t] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1))
total_demand = gp.quicksum(demand_curve[p][t-1] * demand_share[l] for p in products for l in locations for t in range(1, periods + 1))
m.addConstr(total_waste <= waste_limit_pct * total_demand, name="waste_limit")

# Non-negativity
for var in m.getVars():
    if var.VarName.startswith('I_') or var.VarName.startswith('Q_') or var.VarName.startswith('sales_') or var.VarName.startswith('lost_sales_') or var.VarName.startswith('W_'):
        m.addConstr(var >= 0)
